before_claim:
For smooth manifolds $M$ and $N$, the set of smooth-homotopy classes of smooth
maps $M\to N$ is naturally the same as the set of ordinary homotopy classes of
continuous maps $M\to N$.
current_claim:

continuous maps $M\to N$.
